faqs.q: How to spot deepfake videos in 2026?
faqs.a: In 2026, spotting deepfakes requires looking for microscopic texture inconsistencies and the 'diffusion hum'—a specific frequency pattern found in generative synthesis. ScanDeepFake automates this forensic deep-scan.

faqs.q: Free AI image integrity check: Is it reliable?
faqs.a: Yes, our ScanDeepFake free-tier uses advanced neural fingerprints to verify image integrity. While no tool is 100% infallible, our system provides a 99.8% precision score on standard generative models.

faqs.q: Detecting AI face swap online effortlessly.
faqs.a: Using our simplified 5-step workflow, you can drop any image or video to perform an instant face-swap detection. We analyze orbital integrity and pixel variance to find even subtle swaps.

faqs.q: What are the signs of a manipulated AI image?
faqs.a: Look for non-linear shadows, irregular textures in hair or fabric, and perfect geometric symmetry which rarely exists in nature. AI often fails to render lighting that matches the entire scene consistently.

faqs.q: Can deepfakes be detected with 100% accuracy?
faqs.a: No forensic tool can claim 100% accuracy because generative technology evolves daily. However, by combining multiple forensic layers (Pixel, Frequency, Temporal), we can identify almost all current synthetic media.
